subject: Post-call: Spotlight bake-off probes + priority checklist
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@clearpathhealth.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Spotlight bake-off probes + priority checklist

Hi Jordan / Asha —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have clear alignment before the bake-off starts. Please correct anything I got wrong.

Top pain points you shared
- Nightly batch jobs for PHI-sensitive reports are timing out when generating patient aggregations (sporadic latency spikes).
- Model inference cost is becoming a material part of the analytics bill as query volume scales.
- You need stronger auditability (token-level logs + redaction controls) for upcoming audits.

Primary goals for the evaluation
1) Meet 95th percentile latency SLO for 4k-token summaries under realistic concurrency.
2) Reduce per-token inference cost by at least 30% vs current baseline without material quality degradation for summaries.
3) Demonstrate audit trail + SOC2-friendly retention controls.

Decision criteria (proposed prioritization)
- Latency (weighted 35%) — measured @ 95th pctl for target prompt shapes
- Cost (weighted 30%) — unit cost after batching/quantization optimizations
- Accuracy / output parity (weighted 20%) — human-assessed on 50 prompt set
- Operational controls & security (weighted 15%) — KMS/HSM, audit logs, VPC options

Competitive snapshot (vendors you mentioned + one more we’ll include)
- Vendor A (existing infra): good accuracy, poor tail latency at scale
- Vendor B (managed API): easy to integrate, limited audit controls, cost higher under load
- Redwood (us): our plan below — focus on batching + KV cache + quantization options, with per-route policy and an audit log collector you can evaluate

Open / validation probes we committed to run
- End-to-end 4k summarization at 8 concurrent workers (baseline vs redwood runtime with continuous batching) — deliver latency histogram + sample traces
- Cost simulation for your monthly query profile (we’ll provide token-level cost estimates and a delta report)
- Short audit-demo: show log retention + redaction policy applied to a sample run

Attachments: I’ve attached the initial scorecard template and a draft mutual action plan.

Next steps
- Redwood executes the probes above and shares results by Tue 7/27 EOD PT (we’ll drop raw metrics and a one-slide summary).
- Jordan / Asha: confirm the 50 evaluation prompts and any particularly sensitive fields you want redacted by EOD Mon 7/26.
- Quick sync after results — propose Wed 7/28 10:00am PT (30m) for alignment and decisioning.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing this.

—
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[e] evelyn.hart@redwood.com | [m] +1 415-555-0184
[Attachment: spotlight-bakeoff-scorecard.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@clearpathhealth.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Spotlight bake-off probes + priority checklist

Adding a few technical probes / clarifications from the runtime team:

1) Prompt shapes: Please confirm the distribution of prompt lengths (min / median / 95th / max). If you can share a small sample (anonymized) that helps reproduce jitter.

2) KV cache behavior: We will run two KV cache configs — full-prefix caching for repeated patient contexts and a second run with minimal caching to model cold-starts.

3) Quantization profile: We’ll test int8 + awareness of mixed-precision for the 4k experiments; note that int8 can change token-level timing slightly but often reduces cost substantially. We’ll include per-token latency + perplexity delta.

4) Data movement: For the audit demo we’ll redact PHI locally and demonstrate log snapshots and retention policy; need confirmation on redaction fields from Jordan.

I’ve attached a sample kvcache-profile and a short runbook for the tests. Will pair with Karthik to instrument trace IDs so you can map tail latency to model internals in the histograms.

-Camila
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood
[Attachment: sample-kvcache-profile.json (config)]
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Spotlight bake-off probes + priority checklist

Thanks Evelyn & Camila — this looks good and aligned. A couple quick notes:

- Prompt samples: I attached a set of 60 anonymized prompts (patient ids replaced) — please let us know if you need different shapes.
- Priority order: Latency improvement > Cost reduction > Auditability. If any tradeoffs with accuracy are small, we'd accept them for 30% cost savings.
- Redaction fields: please redact patient_ssn, patient_name, and insurance_id. If you can run a quick demo of redaction post-run that’s ideal.

Timeline note: Tue 7/27 EOD for the initial results is tight but doable. We can make a follow-up slot Wed 7/28 10am PT.

Also — please include an apples-to-apples cost model that includes your expected batching/caching assumptions so our finance folks can evaluate.

Best,
Jordan
Director of Analytics | ClearPath Health
[Attachment: clearpath-prompt-sample-60.json (anonymized)]
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@clearpathhealth.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Spotlight bake-off probes + priority checklist

Jordan — perfect, thank you. We confirm redaction fields and received the prompt set. Team will run the three probes and deliver:

- Latency histograms + 95th pctl traces (per scenario)
- Per-token cost model spreadsheet (assumptions tab included)
- Sample run showing redaction and audit log export (short video clip + logs)

Deliverables will be uploaded to the Drive link and I’ll paste the summary slides into HubSpot record 1857342. Camila / Karthik: can you flag any results that trigger a potential SLA/architecture caveat we should call out to the ClearPath execs?

Thanks — we’ll be in touch once the runs finish this evening.

—
Evelyn
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
